samir: FYI we flipped the predictive-prefetch + quant-kernel-coalesce canary on 20 nodes at 08:25. early telemetry: p50 -14%, p95 -20%, p99 -24% for mixed chat+completion workloads; token-unit cost down ~17%. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

lucy: awesome. what did the validation set include?

ci-bot: run=ci_run_20240722_0825_prefetch_coalesce, traces=[chat_peak, longform_steady, embed_mixed], throughput:+10%, kvcache_hit:+8% (short prefixes), report: https://perf.internal/reports/ci_run_20240722_0825_prefetch_coalesce

derek: tell me two-line summary of the technical change?

samir: 1) predictive-prefetch watches short-prefix patterns to warm KV entries proactively; 2) quant-kernel-coalesce groups same-quantized model invocations to avoid costly kernel-switch penalties. config snippet:
```
prefetch:
  enabled: true
  lookback_ms: 120
  min_prefetch_score: 0.6
coalesce:
  quant_grouping: true
  max_group_delay_ms: 45
```

lucy: multiplex/h2 impact?

samir: multiplex p99 tightened ~16ms on avg; streaming p95 improved too. no semantic regressions in eval set. long sequences (>4k tokens) fallback to non-coalesced path.

opsbot: deploy event: canary:eng-runtime/prefetch-coalesce-v1 -> nodes:20 -> status: success -> ts=3456789012

ci-bot: note: slight transient allocation spike during prefetch warmup (<220ms). GC traces recorded under perf/gc/3456789012.

derek: rollout plan?

samir: staged: +40% capacity in 12h, full flip 36-48h if no alerts. keeping canary-oncall pinned for 24h. added enterprise smoke tests to gating suite.

lucy: please draft a 2-sentence note for the eng update after full flip. big win — thanks team. :tada:
